readme: # FoldDevtools > Using chrome devtools to debug WebView, etc. on Android. | | [Download from releases](https://github.com/achyuki/FoldDevtools/releases) | -|- ## Features * Debug local WebView with root access * Debug browser, Node.js, etc. via remote address * Force-enable WebView debugging with XPosed * Use devtools through floating window * Support [Stetho](https://github.com/facebook/stetho)/[StethoX](https://github.com/5ec1cff/StethoX) ## Rootless > [!warning] > For non-rooted Android devices, you need to manually forward the WebView/Stetho debug socket to a local port using adb, and then connect to it (e.g. `127.0.0.1:9222`) using FoldDevtools remote mode. Termux: ``` # Get the debug localsocket name of WebView/Stetho adb shell cat /proc/net/unix | grep devtools_remote # 0000000000000000: 00000002 00000000 00010000 0001 01 xxxxxxx @webview_devtools_remote_ # 0000000000000000: 00000002 00000000 00010000 0001 01 xxxxxxx @stetho__devtools_remote # Perform port forwarding adb forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_ ``` ## Issues Please check [#1](https://github.com/achyuki/FoldDevtools/issues/1) [#2](https://github.com/achyuki/FoldDevtools/issues/2) ## License Licensed under the [GPL-3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html) License.
readmeZh: # FoldDevtools > 在Android上使用chrome devtools调试WebView等。 | | [从版本下载](https://github.com/achyuki/FoldDevtools/releases) | -|- ## 特点 * 使用 root 访问权限调试本地 WebView * 通过远程地址调试浏览器、Node.js等 * 使用 XPosed 强制启用 WebView 调试 * 通过浮动窗口使用devtools * 支持[Stetho](https://github.com/facebook/stetho)/[StethoX](https://github.com/5ec1cff/StethoX) ##无根 > [!警告] > 对于非 root Android 设备，您需要使用 adb 手动将 WebView/Stetho 调试套接字转发到本地端口，然后使用 FoldDevtools 远程模式连接到它（例如 `127.0.0.1:9222`）。 术语： ```` # 获取WebView/Stetho的调试localsocket名称 adb shell cat /proc/net/unix | adb shell cat /proc/net/unix | adb shell cat /proc/net/unix | grep devtools_remote # 0000000000000000: 00000002 00000000 00010000 0001 01 xxxxxxx @webview_devtools_remote_ # 0000000000000000: 00000002 00000000 00010000 0001 01 xxxxxxx @stetho__devtools_remote # 执行端口转发 adb 转发 tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_ ```` ## 问题 请检查 [#1](https://github.com/achyuki/FoldDevtools/issues/1) [#2](https://github.com/achyuki/FoldDevtools/issues/2) ## 许可证 根据 [GPL-3.0](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html) 许可证获得许可。
